scope: Local transcription inventory versus already downloaded structured datasets
method: Source-field WEG product codes; unique catalog match only. DarkStryder labels checked against product code; conflicts excluded from matches. Labels used as fallback. Counts are record references, not coverage percentages. Shared product codes kept ambiguous. Wiki text and other free-text title matching excluded.

statbase.note: Counts of stable-ID rows in direct-conversion Markdown; not a cell-by-cell XLSX audit or deduplication.
